interface.name: processLength
interface.description: Active process-sequence length, 1..8; the final active entry must be station 5.

scan_semantics: Inputs I[k] are sampled at invocation; outputs O[k] are observed after the call. Retained pre-state q[k] becomes q[k+1]. Each test resets the instance. A transition affects the same observed scan. dt_ms is elapsed time since the preceding invocation; the first invocation starts IEC timers at elapsed zero. CycleTime inputs, where supplied, are attributed to the current invocation rather than inferred from dt_ms.
safety_priority: Left and right are mutually exclusive.
Target arrival stops motion before accepting processing completion.
assumptions: The active sequence satisfies the official contract and remains fixed throughout a product cycle.
station1Start is a rising edge accepted with sensor1 while idle.
Destination arrival immediately stops the motor. Completion is accepted only at the current processing wait.
Completion signals are rising edges. Consecutive equal stations denote separate processing operations with fresh edges and no conveyor movement.
Only one sequence-index advancement occurs per invocation. Station5 arrival returns to idle.

formal_properties.name: Interlock
formal_properties.explanation: Both directions can never run together.

formal_properties.name: Direction
formal_properties.explanation: The target/current station order determines direction.

formal_properties.name: Wait
formal_properties.explanation: A processing wait does not move without completion.

formal_properties.name: Output
formal_properties.explanation: The final station completes the sequence.

formal_properties.name: Conditional completion
formal_properties.formula: (G(moving -> F arrive) & G(processing -> F completion)) -> G(started -> F done)
formal_properties.explanation: Under the valid fixed-sequence input contract, eventual external feedback permits every started route to complete.

atomic_propositions.higher: pre-phase MOVING AND targetStation>currentStation AND NOT sensor[targetStation]
atomic_propositions.lower: pre-phase MOVING AND targetStation<currentStation AND NOT sensor[targetStation]
atomic_propositions.waiting: pre-phase WAIT_PROCESS AND no fresh completion edge
atomic_propositions.out: pre-phase MOVING AND targetStation=5 AND sensor5
atomic_propositions.done: post phase IDLE after station5 arrival
atomic_propositions.completion: fresh matching processing-complete edge in the current wait
atomic_propositions.started: station1Start rising edge accepted with sensor1 in idle
